Build the Future of Human Performance

We are engineers, operators, and cognitive scientists building defense-grade intelligence for the people who train, select, and lead under pressure. If that mission resonates, we want to hear from you.

VP of Sales & Business Development

Ramat Gan, Israel (Hybrid)Full-Time · Executive

Build Eyeviation's global commercial engine from the ground up and define how a new category - Human-Aware Autonomous Training - is adopted by defense and government organizations worldwide. Reporting to the CBO, you own global expansion: distribution channels, strategic accounts, the commercial budget, and the team.

What you'll do

  • Design and execute a multi-tier partner network, from major distributors to specialized local resellers
  • Lead complex, long-cycle deals with C-suite executives, senior military leadership, and government procurement
  • Own international trade shows end-to-end: booth strategy, live demos, and post-event conversion
  • Build, allocate, and manage the global commercial budget against revenue targets
  • Establish sales structures and hire commercial talent across B2B, B2G, and G2G tracks

What you bring

  • 8+ years in international business development and sales, with a track record of scaling quotas
  • 4+ years of commercial exposure in Defense or Homeland Security, with international procurement knowledge
  • Proven success across Enterprise (B2B), Institutional (B2G), and Sovereign (G2G) pipelines
  • 2+ years in an early-stage or lean technology company; builds workflows from scratch
  • Native-level Hebrew and executive-level English; willingness to travel 30–50%

Senior C# Engineer

Ramat Gan, Israel (Hybrid)Full-Time

Architect the high-performance software foundation behind our cognitive analytics engine. You will drive remote VR core business logic and orchestration, memory optimization, and network communication — ensuring the system handles massive streams of high-frequency sensor data at scale.

What you'll do

  • Move prototypes into production-ready solutions with high scalability, low latency, and reliability
  • Design networking protocols and IPC for real-time biosensor streams and simulation state sync
  • Lead integration of next-generation VR headsets, controllers, and custom peripherals
  • Pipeline biosensor data and AI feedback into the core engine with Data Science and Product
  • Own the full lifecycle from low-level design to shipped software

What you bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on software development, with recent roles focused on C# and .NET
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science or a related quantitative field
  • Deep OS fundamentals: memory management, storage I/O, and inter-process communication
  • Solid networking: TCP/UDP, socket programming, high-frequency serialization
  • Bonus: Unity3D, 3D math, Android NDK, C++/Python, XR devices, eye-tracking or biosensors

C++ Software Engineer

Ramat Gan, Israel (Hybrid)Full-Time

Join the core engineering team behind IPASS and shape how the system evolves — from implementing new simulator capabilities to integrating eye trackers, XR headsets, and real-time communication between processes. A hands-on role for an engineer who wants to understand the entire system, not just one piece of code.

What you'll do

  • Design, develop, and maintain software components for the IPASS platform in modern C++
  • Integrate with flight simulators and simulator SDKs (Prepar3D, VBS, X-Plane)
  • Work with XR/VR systems, eye tracking, joysticks, throttles, and simulator peripherals
  • Build real-time communication and data-flow components across the system
  • Collect, process, and expose simulator and trainee data for analysis and evaluation
  • Own features from design through implementation, integration, testing, and deployment

What you bring

  • B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering field
  • 3–5 years of C++ development experience on Windows-based real-time systems
  • Strong OOP, data structures, memory management, and multithreading fundamentals
  • Ability to navigate a large existing codebase and investigate unfamiliar systems and APIs
  • Advantage: flight simulators, Unreal/Unity, VR/XR, Varjo headsets, or Tobii eye tracking

Full Stack Engineer

Ramat Gan, Israel (Hybrid)Full-Time

Join the IPASS team and own the product-services layer that connects our real-time simulator environment to cloud services, databases, web applications, analytics, and operational tools. A backend-oriented role (approximately 70% backend / 30% frontend) for an engineer who can take a feature from system design through deployment.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs for the product platform
  • Develop services for authentication, trainee management, missions, scenarios, and assessments
  • Build reliable flows for ingesting simulator telemetry and eye-tracking data
  • Build and maintain web applications, dashboards, and internal tools in React and TypeScript
  • Support deployment, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, observability, and cloud environments

What you bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful backend ownership
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and REST API design
  • Strong experience with SQL relational databases and data modeling
  • Strong working knowledge of React for production-quality web interfaces
  • Experience with a major cloud platform, Git, Docker, and CI/CD workflows
